name: Mall Service Desk
summary: A stepped walnut service counter with jade panels, brass trim, open staff side and an editable raised service sign.
description: A stepped walnut service counter with jade panels, brass trim, open staff side and an editable raised service sign.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. Blender bundled Bfont labels are converted to mesh in the GLB. No external textures or models.
accuracy_notes: Original decorative concept, not an official mall product or engineering, accessibility-compliance or fabrication specification. Static counter and sign; no service workflow or sign interaction is implemented. Dimensions measured from actual GLB.

attribution.credit: Original geometry authored for Blender-3D-Gallery. Labels use Blender bundled Bfont, retained as editable source text and exported as geometry.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
